creativetab.nomendubium.title: Nomen Dubium
item.nomendubium.encased_fossil.tooltip: Restore it at a Paleontology Table to uncover a fossil.
item.nomendubium.fossil.tooltip.1: ● Place a body fossil on the ground to begin assembling a skeleton
item.nomendubium.fossil.tooltip.2: ● Use head, tail, and back fossils on the body to attach them
item.nomendubium.fossil.hulking_body.too: ● High knockback resistance and powerful attack knockback
item.nomendubium.fossil.shelled_body.too: ● Very tough and resistant, moving efficiently through water and lava
item.nomendubium.fossil.avian_body.toolt: ● The fastest body, but with light armor and low knockback resistance
item.nomendubium.fossil.lanky_body.toolt: ● Jumps very high and withstands long falls
item.nomendubium.fossil.puffy_body.toolt: ● Applies bone meal nearby every 5 seconds while moving
item.nomendubium.fossil.crunching_head.t: ● Applies damage (click while riding to bite every enemy ahead)
item.nomendubium.fossil.shielded_head.to: ● Applies damage and knockback (click while riding to charge forward)
item.nomendubium.fossil.snarled_head.too: ● Roars in combat to grant Strength to nearby allies
item.nomendubium.fossil.beaked_head.tool: ● Applies damage, poison and blindness (click while riding to peck enemies ahead)
item.nomendubium.fossil.snorting_head.to: ● Extracts resources from the ground (click while riding to extract resources)
item.nomendubium.fossil.stubby_tail.tool: ● Allows the Chimera to attack more quickly
item.nomendubium.fossil.fan_tail.tooltip: ● Sweeps enemies around the primary attack target
item.nomendubium.fossil.speared_tail.too: ● Increases damage and converts melee hits to magic damage
item.nomendubium.amber.tooltip: Eat it to receive a vision from the past
item.nomendubium.fossil_bone.tooltip: Restore it in a Tree of Life to create a Regenerating Chop
item.nomendubium.sap_of_life.tooltip.1: ● Eat it to gain Regeneration until you take damage
item.nomendubium.sap_of_life.tooltip.2: ● Tames wild Chimeras and heals Chimeras you own
item.nomendubium.fruit_of_life.tooltip: Use it on a complete fossil skeleton to revive it as a Chimera
item.nomendubium.fossilised_apple.toolti: Restore it in a Tree of Life to obtain a random kind of apple
item.nomendubium.fossilised_shell.toolti: Restore it in a Tree of Life to obtain a random aquatic treasure
item.nomendubium.shattered_diamond.toolt: Restore it in a Tree of Life to turn it back into a Diamond
item.nomendubium.hunters_arrow.tooltip: A stronger arrow that shatters against armored targets
item.nomendubium.primitive_arrow.tooltip: A crude arrow that shatters against armored targets
item.nomendubium.prehistoric_maw.tooltip: ● Hold use, then release to throw it and see it become a boomerang
● Kills increase its damage, while throwing it and time slowly reduces it
● Hold use, then release to throw it through multiple targets
● It can be picked up again after landing.
item.nomendubium.regenerating_chop.toolt: ● Can be eaten three times before it needs to regenerate
● Slowly restores its uses while carried.
message.nomendubium.fruit_of_life.incomp: The skeleton needs a body, head, and tail.
vision.nomendubium.amber.1: A complete skeleton is only waiting for a heartbeat
vision.nomendubium.amber.2: Feed the oldest roots, and they will return what was lost
vision.nomendubium.amber.3: Some fossils still dream of walking
vision.nomendubium.amber.life_hollow_mis: You are too far away... I cannot reach you
